title: Quartakk
extract:
The Quartakk is a  Grineer quad-barreled heavy burst rifle that fires 4 bullets simultaneously in a single burst. Its slow fire rate is compensated by possessing very high burst damage, high accuracy and status chance, and good critical chance.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Innate 0.5 meter punch through.
Uniquely fires all four shots simultaneously instead of consecutively, reducing the chance of one missing.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Primary Burst Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with  Kuva Quartakk for the second highest status chance of all burst-fire rifles, behind  Paracyst/ Burston Prime.
Largest magazine size of all burst-fire rifles.
Burst-Fire (wiki attack index 1)
Very high magazine size (84)
High damage per shot (244.41)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
Very high accuracy (1.00° to 1.20°)
High reload speed (1.90 s)
Very high ammo max (840)
Above average status chance (27.00%)
High crit multiplier (2.30x)
Disadvantages over other Primary Burst Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Linearly less efficient – sometimes a target may only die with five bullets, which requires an entire second burst to be fired.
Each shot lands in a small square formation around where the user is aiming instead of directly on the crosshair, which may lead to misses against smaller targets.
Burst-Fire (wiki attack index 1)
Below average crit chance (19.00%)
Very low burst DPS (96.54)
Very low sustained DPS (93.21)
Very low fire rate (1.58 attacks/sec)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
The Quartakk's blueprint can be acquired as a reward from performing special Ghoul Purge Bounties, or dropped by Ghoul Auger Alphas. The built weapon can also be bought from the Market individually, or as part of the Maggor Assault Pack.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

This weapon can be sold for  7,500. The blueprint for this weapon can be sold for  2,500.

Trivia
The name Quartakk may be derived from the Latin word Quartus, meaning "fourth," a reference to the weapon's four barrels.
Prior to Update 22.9 (2018-01-17), the Quartakk functioned as a semi-automatic rifle that fired four bullets per shot. This caused the weapon's status chance to behave similarly to multi-pellet shotguns, in that the listed status chance was split between each bullet. After the update, the Quartakk was changed into a burst-fire rifle firing four bullets simultaneously, resulting in each bullet having the listed status chance instead of being split.
Despite Update 27.2 (2020-03-05)'s changes to status multishot properly listing status per projectile, Quartakk is still labeled as a burst rifle.
